violation_type.title: Personnel Record Storage (26 TAC §746.907(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, a violation was found. The operation did not have records available for two caregivers during the DFPS face-to-face visit. One caregiver's last day of employment was two months before the day of the visit per the director, but no documents were provided, and the second caregiver was present, and no file was available during the DFPS face-to-face visit. The DFPS was not able to review any records during the visit and also requested records by email, and no records were sent.
